tellings.link_reason: Matthew Brown again places exotic technology work at US national labs, the same claim as the story that reverse engineering is run out of national labs.

as_told.title: National labs store samples of exotic technology

plain: Work on taking apart and copying non-human technology, known in this field as reverse engineering, is "ongoing and is ran out of our national labs for sure", according to Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official presented as a whistleblower, who partly relays what others told him. He tells Michels the national labs are also "where samples are stored of exotic technologies". If true, the government's own research labs would be holding and studying such material.
